entry.title: Updated: dsh-opencodego-usage
entry.summary: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials. Exact install spec: github:beizi6/dsh-opencodego-usage. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
